definitions.explanation: A school that offers advanced academic degrees after completing undergraduate studies.

examples.japanese: {大学院|だいがくいん}に{進学|しんがく}する。
{大学院|だいがくいん}で{研究|けんきゅう}している。
examples.english: I'm doing research in graduate school.

examples.japanese: {大学院|だいがくいん}{修士|しゅうし}{課程|かてい}を{修了|しゅうりょう}した。

notes:
Japanese graduate schools typically have {修士|しゅうし}{課程|かてい} (master's program) and {博士|はかせ}{課程|かてい} (doctoral program).

Common expressions:
- {大学院|だいがくいん}に{進|すす}む (to advance to graduate school)
- {大学院|だいがくいん}{生|せい} (graduate student)
- {大学院|だいがくいん}{入試|にゅうし} (graduate school entrance exam)
